grammar.purpose: Identify the stated cause and consequence
grammar.explanation: 因为先分好工作，所以大家没有重复劳动 connects a stated cause with its consequence. A consequence is not proof that every earlier event caused it. Either connective may be omitted when the relation is clear, but 但是 marks contrast instead. Use the evidence in the scene, not a new causal story invented from a score or appearance.

examples.zh: 因为先分好工作，所以更顺利。
examples.py: yīn wèi xiān fēn hǎo gōng zuò , suǒ yǐ gèng shùn lì .
examples.en: Because the work was divided first, things went more smoothly.

examples.zh: 因为下雨，我们换了地方。
examples.py: yīn wèi xià yǔ , wǒ men huàn le dì fāng .
examples.en: Because it rained, we changed the location.

examples.zh: 大家先确认了，所以不用再猜。
examples.py: dà jiā xiān què rèn le , suǒ yǐ bù yòng zài cāi .
examples.en: Everyone confirmed first, so there is no need to guess again.

commonMistakes.wrong: 因为下雨，所以太阳就是经理。
commonMistakes.right: 因为下雨，所以我们换了地方。
commonMistakes.why: Supply the actual consequence rather than an unrelated identity.

grammar.pattern: 给 + 接收者 / 受益者
grammar.purpose: Retrieve the recipient in a recap
grammar.explanation: 给朋友倒水 identifies who receives water; 给老师发消息 identifies the message recipient. It does not mean the recipient did the pouring or sending. Say the recipient when the context needs one, and distinguish an offer from its accepted completion.

examples.py: wǒ gěi péng you dào shuǐ .
examples.en: I pour water for a friend.

examples.py: tā gěi lǎo shī fā xiāo xī .
examples.en: She sends the teacher a message.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ zhào xiàng , kě yǐ ma ?
examples.en: I would like to photograph you; is that okay?

commonMistakes.wrong: 我给朋友倒水，所以朋友给我倒水。
commonMistakes.right: 我给朋友倒水，朋友收到了水。
commonMistakes.why: Do not reverse the agent and recipient.

grammar.purpose: Retrieve ordinal steps in an explanation
grammar.explanation: 第一步查做法，第二步分工作，最后核对结果 states an ordered plan. 第一 is ordinal and differs from 一次, a count. An ordered plan is not itself proof that every step was done. Match the recap with the actual scene and preserve a missed or unfinished step.

examples.zh: 第一步看通知，第二步问时间。
examples.py: dì yī bù kàn tōng zhī , dì èr bù wèn shí jiān .
examples.en: First check the notice; second ask the time.

examples.py: zuì hòu hé duì jié guǒ .
dì sān bù hái méi zuò .
examples.en: The third step has not been done yet.

commonMistakes.wrong: 第一步还没做，所以都做完了。
commonMistakes.right: 第一步还没做，不能说都做完了。
commonMistakes.why: An unfinished step prevents a claim that all steps are complete.

lines.zh: 今天为什么更顺利？
lines.py: jīn tiān wèi shén me gèng shùn lì ?
lines.en: Why did things go more smoothly today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 因为先分好工作，所以没有重复做。
lines.py: yīn wèi xiān fēn hǎo gōng zuò , suǒ yǐ méi yǒu chóng fù zuò .
lines.en: Because we divided the work first, we did not duplicate the tasks.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 第一步查做法，第二步做饭，最后核对结果。
lines.py: dì yī bù chá zuò fa , dì èr bù zuò fàn , zuì hòu hé duì jié guǒ .
lines.en: First check the method, second prepare the meal, finally check the results.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你给谁倒水？
lines.py: nǐ gěi shéi dào shuǐ ?
lines.en: For whom did you pour water?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 给朋友。他不喝酒。
lines.py: gěi péng you . tā bù hē jiǔ .
lines.en: For a friend; he does not drink alcohol.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 大家都照相了吗？
lines.py: dà jiā dōu zhào xiàng le ma ?
lines.en: Did everyone have a photo taken?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 没有。有人不想照，我们还没问完。
lines.py: méi yǒu . yǒu rén bù xiǎng zhào , wǒ men hái méi wèn wán .
lines.en: No. Some do not want a photo; we have not finished asking.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，先别说所有事都完成。
lines.py: hǎo , xiān bié shuō suǒ yǒu shì dōu wán chéng .
lines.en: Okay; do not say everything is finished yet.
lines.speaker: b

choices: A friend who does not drink alcohol
questions.answer: A friend who does not drink alcohol

questions.q: Is the photo task complete for everyone?

reading.title: The evening record
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Separate completed work from a request still awaiting consent.

lines.zh: 因为先查做法、分工作，所以做饭更顺利。
lines.py: yīn wèi xiān chá zuò fa , fēn gōng zuò , suǒ yǐ zuò fàn gèng shùn lì .
lines.en: Checking the method and dividing work first made cooking smoother.

lines.zh: 第一步查，第二步做，最后核对；不是只写顺序就算完成。
lines.py: dì yī bù chá , dì èr bù zuò , zuì hòu hé duì ; bù shì zhǐ xiě shùn xù jiù suàn wán chéng .
lines.en: Check first, do second and verify last; merely writing the order does not complete it.

lines.zh: 我给朋友倒水，朋友不是倒水的人。
lines.py: wǒ gěi péng you dào shuǐ , péng you bù shì dào shuǐ de rén .
lines.en: I poured water for a friend; the friend was not the person doing the pouring.

lines.zh: 纸掉了，朋友拉开椅子，我捡起来。
lines.py: zhǐ diào le , péng you lā kāi yǐ zi , wǒ jiǎn qǐ lái .
lines.en: The paper fell; my friend moved the chair and I picked it up.

lines.zh: 大门外有行人，大家排队，让开人行道。
lines.py: dà mén wài yǒu xíng rén , dà jiā pái duì , ràng kāi rén xíng dào .
lines.en: There are pedestrians outside the entrance; everyone queues and keeps the pavement clear.

lines.zh: 一座楼前有一排椅子，第一排不等于第一座。
lines.py: yī zuò lóu qián yǒu yī pái yǐ zi , dì yī pái bù děng yú dì yī zuò .
lines.en: There is a row of chairs before a building; first row is not first building.

lines.zh: 有人求帮忙推门，猫和狗都先留在屋里。
lines.py: yǒu rén qiú bāng máng tuī mén , māo hé gǒu dōu xiān liú zài wū lǐ .
lines.en: Someone asks for help pushing the door; the cat and dog stay inside first.

lines.zh: 照相还没问完，不愿意的人不照；记录不写全部完成。
lines.py: zhào xiàng hái méi wèn wán , bù yuàn yì de rén bù zhào ; jì lù bù xiě quán bù wán chéng .
lines.en: Photo consent has not all been requested; those unwilling are not photographed, and the record does not say everything is complete.

choices: Actual roles, results and unfinished consent
Only a claim of total success
